verdict.rationale: The only filing-related evidence is a one-line claim that the Avalara Managed Returns API, a companion product rather than AvaTax itself, lets platforms embed tax return preparation and filing. A community comment notes that AvaTax-style tools cover tax collection but filing must be handled separately, which suggests an extra product is needed. Missing for 10: a filing calendar of upcoming returns, per-filing status tracking, amounts remitted, downloadable filing confirmations, in-depth docs, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
